data.value: 1. Adding Rows Instantiate a new DataRow using the .NewRow() method, populate the columns, and append it using Rows.Add(). 2. Editing Rows To modify a row safely, call .BeginEdit(), change the data, and then call .EndEdit() to confirm or .CancelEdit() to abort. 3. Deleting Data The .Remove() method deletes a row immediately. However, the .Delete() method only marks the row for deletion within the DataSet. 4. State Management Because changes happen in memory, you must call .AcceptChanges() to commit additions/deletions permanently, or .RejectChanges() to undo them
